_readme: Hand-picked Pinterest inspiration for Promo Suggestions. Key = product code (e.g. cake00KA001234), or the lower-cased pick name / category path. Each pin: url (https://www.pinterest.com/pin/<id>/), style (Poster | Editorial | Metaphor | Flat-lay | Festive | Lifestyle ...), note (why it fits, one line). Aim for 2-3 pins per pick and MIX styles - never three of the same look.
